material_definitions: The materials studied are LISICON solid solution series Li3P(1-x)VxO4, Li(3+x)V(1-x)GexO4, and Li(3+x)P(1-x)GexO4 (x = 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 and 1).
X-ray diffraction analysis revealed that these samples were phase pure.
Compounds without partial lithium occupancy (e.g., Li3P(1-x)VxO4 and Li4GeO4) were measured over the temperature range 90 °C to 150 °C.
Aliovalent substitution of P5+ or V5+ for Ge4+ creates partial lithium occupancy resulting in much higher conductivities and lower activation energies.
warnings: Raw conductivity value was approximated in source text (~2x10^-9)
